The Scope Router primitive embodies a top-down hierarchical navigation mechanism, structurally analogous to a directed acyclic graph traversal algorithm where each node represents a conceptual domain. It enables rapid localization of relevant knowledge modules by aligning user intent with semantic embeddings stored in the academy-corpus. The Agent Loop primitive formalizes autonomous decision-making as a recurrent process, akin to a control theory feedback system with internal state updates. Its kernel maps to a reinforcement learning policy where actions are selected to maximize expected utility over future states. The AI Fluency Framework introduces a multidimensional constraint space—Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence—that acts as a normative filter on agent behavior, ensuring alignment with human values and intentions. These three primitives form a triadic structure: Scope Router provides the topology, Agent Loop governs dynamics, and AI Fluency Framework enforces semantics. Their interplay defines the operational envelope of intelligent systems within structured knowledge domains.
